Financial stability was verified via D&B credit check, report DNB-2024-8823, with acceptable financial health. Security assessment was passed with documented results in SA-2024-Q2-114, and ISO 27001 certification was verified.
- Findings: The request includes documented qualification review, financial verification, and security assessment results. These are relevant factors for evaluating supplier suitability. No recommendation is provided.
